slides.title: One card for the morning after a broken night
slides.body: Fill it in in two minutes. No app, no tracking streaks.

slides.title: Record the context
slides.body: Night waking. Current fatigue. Willingness to move. What's fixed in your day.

slides.title: Answer the capacity questions
slides.body: How much usable energy is here now? Does gentle movement feel OK? Does the plan still fit?

slides.title: Select one outcome
slides.body: Modified plan, gentle activity or deliberate rest. Tick one.

slides.title: State it and set the boundary
slides.body: "Today I'm choosing a short easy walk. I'll stop if it stops feeling comfortable."

slides.title: The card is printable
slides.body:
